slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does every product have to be processed on all three machines in the fixed order Machine 1 → Machine 2 → Machine 3 (a flow shop), or can a product skip some machines?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether products follow a fixed machine sequence, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total time until all three products are completely finished (i.e., the makespan, the time when the last product leaves Machine 3)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for clarification of the objective and whether it means makespan.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; remaining questions concerned P2 or minor modeling details.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved both P0 hidden slots—the fixed machine sequence and the makespan objective—before stopping, and also clarified several secondary scheduling assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
